output.explanation: Expanded workspace into a browser ownership spine plus two peripherals: workspace-sessions exposes the registry -> draft -> session -> controller composition; workspace-surface exposes renderer-local models, routing, editor adapters and overlay components. Kept domain and backend ASCII unchanged as companion views of shared semantics and external services. Verified ownership and callbacks against the pinned checkout, including App/services, MappingPage, workspace/session/persistence classes, tldraw adapters, history service and backend bootstrap. Clarified that surfaces borrow sessions, history remains injected, and persistence belongs to the page. Corrected the blanket BOTH-controller transfer claim: undo/redo of a newly created projection copy replaces only the child while retaining the source. All existing edges are retained, with moved endpoints reattached; new edges expose session borrowing, gesture commits, driver attachment and persistence notifications.

|           |-- Read-only store facades over private Zustand stores
|           |   |-- document / presentation / selection

|           |   |-- Snapshot and editing-context handle (see domain)

|           |   `-- Optional live editor driver -> borrowed from mounted surface
|           |-- Controller subscription
|           |   |-- Snapshot changes -> synchronously publish affected stores
|           |   `-- Changed canvasRevisionId -> onCommit listeners
|           `-- dispose(): clear cursor copy; unsubscribe; clear commit listeners
|-- Controller index: aliases each draft.session.controller
|-- Subscriptions per draft
|   |-- onCommit -> changes version + onPersist(document IDs)
|   |-- status -> dirty-scene ID index
|   `-- document -> refreshed draft entry for search/explorer
|-- setDrafts(): seeds create sessions; existing handles are reused
|   |-- Metadata updates -> session.updateBaseline()
|   |-- Removed/replaced sessions -> unsubscribe, remove index entry, dispose
|   `-- Changed IDs -> onPersist -> page-owned WorkspacePersistence
|-- copyDocument(): fork history and clone canvas -> new draft/session
|   `-- -> shared history service; separate editing handle, selection cleared
`-- dispose(): release subscriptions and all remaining sessions
